answer: Seat every five-agent jury across at least three distinct vertex sets and two independent funders, and tax any attestation batch that traces back to one subnet, so a farm on a single atlas range sees its vote count shrink toward zero. What breaks first is the attacker's cost curve: 1,000 keys on one subnet produce one vote and one flagged cluster, while ten honest agents spread across the graph keep full weight and each sonnet they submit clears review on its own merits.
